name: opentodo
description: Connect Claude to your own OpenTodo server: read your tasks and, when you allow it, plan and change them, with every change in the task's history and undoable.

server_url.title: OpenTodo server address
server_url.description: The address you open OpenTodo at, such as https://todo.example.com (without /mcp).

agent_token.title: Agent token
agent_token.description: An agent token from Settings → Integrations → AI assistants (or a read-only token for an assistant that only looks).
